title: LLMs4Subjects - Subject Tagging for a Technical Library
description: Subject indexing of technical bibliographic records for the TIB Leibniz Information Centre's open-access TIBKAT catalog. Annotators assign subject headings and record types to English/German technical records, mirroring the library workflow SemEval-2025 Task 5 automates with LLMs. This showcase is a simplified adaptation of that task.
